headline: Gigafactory worth billions of zlotys. Important deadline may be postponed
summary: The deadline for bids on the Port Polska terminal construction is likely to be postponed, CPK chief Piotr Borys said, as contractors need more time and documentation needs revisions.
why: Central Communication Port (CPK) is Poland's state body building the Port Polska airport, a large infrastructure project that matters for construction contractors and public spending.
original_headline: Gigalotnisko za miliardy złotych. Ważny termin może się przesunąć
